status.active: Active on your local network · Paired devices: {count}
action.pauseHint: While paused, no tablet can press keys on this PC
alert.pairingAttempts: There were many failed pairing attempts, so pairing was paused for a minute. If it wasn't you, someone on your network is trying to connect.
connect.intro: To pair a tablet, scan whichever QR works with its camera. The others simply won't open. Each QR works for one device only.
connect.codeHint: To type it on the tablet by hand. It expires in {time} or once used, and renews itself.
connect.thisPcHint: Use shards on this screen, no tablet needed
devices.intro: Each paired tablet has its own key. Unpairing one disconnects it at once; it will have to scan the QR again.
devices.none: No devices are paired yet. Go to Connect and scan a QR with the tablet.
devices.name: Device name
shards.dropHint: You can also drag a .zip, a .libreshard file, a folder or a Stream Deck profile onto this window.
shards.dropHere: Drop the shard here to review it
shards.pendingIntro: Shards with pending permissions: {count}. Their new keys won't work until you review and approve them.
shards.installed.toast: "{name}" is installed and already shows up on the tablet.
risk.warning: Warning: this shard can open the system's "Run" box (or similar shortcuts) and also type text and press Enter. With that it could run any command on your PC. Only install it if you trust its author.
risk.system: This shard uses system shortcuts (Windows key, Alt+F4 or Ctrl+Alt). Check that they make sense for what it does.
risk.canType: This shard can type free text and press Enter.
risk.noApps: It isn't limited to any app: its keys act on whatever app is in the foreground.
review.updateFrom: It will be updated from version {from} to {to}.
review.pendingKeys: Unapproved keys: {count} (marked in gold). They won't work until you approve them.
review.keys: Keys it will be able to press ({count})
settings.portHint: Only change it if another program uses 7878. Tablets will have to scan the new QR.
settings.confirmDevicesHint: Every time a tablet tries to pair, this PC will ask you before accepting it.
settings.publicNetworksHint: When off, only devices on your local network or on a VPN such as Tailscale are accepted. Only turn it on if you know what you're doing.
settings.restartNeeded: Restart LibreShard to apply the changes.
backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Save your settings, app rules, shard order and settings, and the shards you installed in one file, to move them to another PC or keep a copy. Paired devices aren't included: tablets pair again.
backup.busy: Finish reviewing the shards of the backup you're importing first.
backup.gone: This backup is no longer open; pick it again.
backup.nothing: Nothing would change: this PC already has everything in the backup.
backup.securityNote: Some of these settings decide who can connect to this PC or what tablets may do. Check them before importing.
backup.rules: Restores where {count} shards may act (app rules).
backup.states: Restores the order, favorites, on/off and settings of {count} shards.
backup.installHint: Each one goes through the usual review, with all its keys, before anything is installed.
backup.kept: Already installed here, kept as they are: {names}.
backup.never: Paired devices and key approvals are never imported.
about.title: About
about.updateFailed: Couldn't check for a new version. LibreShard will try again later.
about.updatePending: LibreShard checks for new versions a minute after starting.
settings.checkUpdates: Check for new versions of LibreShard and of gallery shards
settings.checkUpdatesHint: Once a day LibreShard asks GitHub which version is the latest and, if you installed shards, reads the gallery's list on libreshard.com. It sends nothing about you, your devices or your shards, and never installs anything by itself.
about.license: Free and open source software under the Apache 2.0 license.
about.problemsHint: "Report a bug" copies the diagnostics and opens the report form on GitHub; paste them in its last field and read everything before sending. The diagnostics and the log have no device names, network addresses or keys typed.
about.reportOpened: Diagnostics copied: paste them in the form's last field and read them before sending.
dialog.portInUse:
Port {port} is already used by another program.

Close that program, or change "port" in this file and open LibreShard again:
{file}

If you change the port, tablets will have to scan the new QR.
dialog.confirmDevice.detail: A device with IP {ip} wants to pair using the current code or QR.
dialog.removeDevice.detail: It will be disconnected at once and will have to scan the QR again to use LibreShard.
dialog.uninstall.detail: Its folder will be deleted from the shards folder.
dialog.uninstall.detailLinked: It's a link to a development folder: only the link is removed, your files are left alone.
apps.title: Where it acts
apps.modeAnyHint: Its keys act on whatever app is in the foreground.
apps.modeOnlyHint: If you tap a button with another app in front, nothing is pressed and the tablet says so.
apps.empty: Add at least one app, or choose "In any app".
apps.detectHint: Bring the app you want to add to the front before the countdown ends.
apps.detectFailed: The foreground app couldn't be detected.
apps.detectSelf: LibreShard was still in front. Click "Detect app" and switch to the app you want before the countdown ends.
apps.noneOpen: No other apps have an open window.
apps.textTitle: Or type part of the name
apps.textHint: Matches any program whose name contains that text. Picking the app is more precise.
apps.titleOnly: This PC can only read the window title: the text is looked for in the title.
apps.saved: Saved: “{name}” now uses the new apps.
apps.restored: The suggested apps for “{name}” were restored.
settings.allowAppsFromTabletHint: When a shard doesn't act because another app is in front, the tablet offers "Allow here too" and adds that app.
settings.panelAlwaysOnTop: Keep this PC's panel on top
settings.panelAlwaysOnTopHint: The panel window stays above every other window.
viewer.title: Your shards
viewer.subtitle: Pick one to open it full screen.
viewer.paused: LibreShard is paused on the PC: no keys are pressed
viewer.offline: No connection to the PC. Reconnecting…
viewer.pairPrompt: Scan the QR on the PC or type the pairing code LibreShard shows
viewer.pending: Waiting for you to accept this device on the PC…
viewer.blocked: Not run. This shard only works in {apps}.
viewer.blockedSelf: Nothing was pressed: LibreShard is in front. Switch to the app you want to control first.
viewer.updateAvailable: LibreShard was updated on the PC. Reload to use the new version.
viewer.blockedElevated: Nothing was pressed: {app} runs as administrator and ignores keys from LibreShard. Close LibreShard and open it as administrator too.
viewer.panelReopen: The panel lost its connection to LibreShard. Close it and open it again from the "This PC" card.
viewer.activeUnknown: The active app couldn't be detected.
viewer.allowed: Done: this shard now works in {app} too. Tap the button again.
viewer.allowFailed: The app couldn't be added. Tap the button again with that app in front.
viewer.revoked: This device is no longer paired. Scan the QR on the PC or type the pairing code.
viewer.qrUsed: This QR was already used or expired. Scan the one the PC shows now, or type the code.
viewer.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} s and try again.
viewer.noConnection: Couldn't connect to the PC. Check that LibreShard is open.
viewer.fullscreenFailed: The browser didn't allow full screen.
viewer.autoFullscreenHint: When you pick a shard from the menu. Saved on this device only.
viewer.noShards: No shards are active. Install one from the LibreShard window on the PC.
viewer.pendingPerms: Pending permissions: review them on the PC
viewer.listFailed: The shard list couldn't be loaded.
viewer.keyUnavailable: This PC's keyboard has no {keys} key, so it wasn't pressed.
viewer.focusPaused: Paused: this shard acts in {apps}. {app} is in front now.
viewer.focusUnknown: Paused: the PC can't tell which app is in front.
review.linkNote: The folder is linked, not copied: every time you save a file, the tablet reloads the shard. If you add keys to the manifest, you'll have to approve them again.
shardSettings.title: Shard settings
shardSettings.hint: The shard gets the changes right away, without reloading.
shardSettings.restored: The default settings for “{name}” were restored.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
settings.closeToTrayHint: Tablets keep working with the window closed. To quit completely, use "Quit" on the tray icon.
settings.openAtLoginHint: LibreShard starts with the system, showing only the tray icon.
panel.title: LibreShard · This PC
tray.stillRunning: LibreShard is still running in the tray. Tablets can keep using it.
dialog.pickDevFolder: Choose the folder of the shard you're developing
shards.orderHint: This is the order of the tablet's menu. Favorites (★) come first; the arrows move each shard within its group.
editor.unsavedDetail: If you close the editor now, they are lost.
editor.unreadable: This shard can't be opened in the editor: {error}
editor.invalid:
The shard has parts that can't be saved:
{details}
editor.nameRequired: Give the shard a name before saving it.
editor.saved: Saved. Tablets showing this shard reload it.
editor.savedNew: Saved. The shard is already in the tablet menu.
editor.name: Name
editor.gridShrink: {count} buttons don't fit in the smaller grid and will be removed. Continue?
editor.pageBar: Show page tabs on the tablet
editor.pageDeleteConfirm: Delete the page "{name}" and its {count} buttons?
editor.selectHint: Click an empty cell of the grid to add a button, or a button to change it. Drag to move it, and pull its corner to make it bigger.
editor.noRoom: There's no room for that in the grid.
editor.type.label: Text only
editor.typeHint.press: One tap presses the key or combination.
editor.typeHint.hold: The key stays pressed while the finger is on the button (Shift, Alt, push to talk).
editor.typeHint.repeat: Presses once and again and again while held, like the volume.
editor.typeHint.toggle: Each tap alternates: the first key, then the second. Each state has its own look.
editor.typeHint.page: Shows another page of this shard.
editor.typeHint.label: A title or a note: it presses nothing.
editor.typeHint.none: This button does nothing on the tablet; it looks dimmed. Choose what it should do.
editor.keyUnknown: LibreShard can't press "{key}" yet. It can press the keys listed in "Choose…".
editor.label: Text
editor.incomplete: {count} buttons still need a key or a page (marked with "!").
editor.incompleteSave: This button still needs a key or a page.
editor.unavailable: This PC's keyboard has no {keys} key: those buttons would do nothing on this PC (they may work on another one).
editor.tooManyKeys: The shard uses {count} different keys; the limit is {max}.
editor.small: {count} buttons are smaller than 48 px at this preview size: hard to hit with a finger.
editor.loadWarnings: Some parts of this shard were invalid and were left out: {details}
editor.captureHint: Hold the keys, then release them all to finish. For a Windows Alt code, hold Alt and type the digits on the numeric keypad.
editor.imageInvalid: That file isn't an image LibreShard can use (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF).
editor.imageTooBig: That image is too big (20 MB at most).
editor.imageHint: It is shrunk to 288 px and saved as PNG. The text goes over it.
look.themeHint: Choosing a theme clears your own settings below (Undo brings them back).
look.contrast: The text and the buttons are hard to tell apart (contrast {ratio}:1; at least 4.5:1 is advised).
look.tabsHidden: Tabs only show with more than one page and "Show page tabs on the tablet" on.
export.title: Export shard
export.saved: "{name}" was exported. Share the .libreshard file: a double click opens it in LibreShard.
export.tooBig: This shard is too big to share: other PCs only install up to {files} files and {size} MB.
export.importedMessage: This shard has images from a Stream Deck profile
export.importedDetail: Share it only if you have the right to share those images (they may belong to whoever made the profile or its icons).
import.editorOpen: Close the shard editor first: it edits one shard at a time.
import.error.notZip: This file couldn't be read: it isn't a valid Stream Deck profile.
import.error.notProfile: This file isn't a Stream Deck profile. Export the profile from the Stream Deck app and open that file.
import.error.oldFormat: This profile comes from an old version of the Stream Deck app (4.x), which LibreShard can't read. Open it in a current version and export it again.
import.error.invalid: This Stream Deck profile is damaged or in a format LibreShard doesn't know.
import.error.empty: This Stream Deck profile has no pages to import.
import.summary: Imported from a Stream Deck profile: {imported} of {total} buttons work. It isn't saved yet.
import.dials: {count} dial or touch strip actions weren't imported.
import.missingPages: {count} pages of the profile were missing from the file.
import.short.keyLogicEmpty: Key Logic without a single press
import.short.review: keys the profile wasn't clear about
import.reason.noKey: Stream Deck: this button had no key.
import.reason.sequence: Stream Deck: a sequence of keys. Sequences will come with macros; pick one key for now.
import.reason.unsupportedKey: Stream Deck: a key LibreShard can't press ({detail}).
import.reason.stop: Stream Deck: Stop (media). LibreShard has no Stop key; Play/Pause may do.
import.reason.pageIndicator: Stream Deck: page indicator. The tabs at the top already show the page.
import.reason.keyLogicEmpty: Stream Deck: Key Logic without a single press.
import.reason.text: Stream Deck: Text (types a text). Not available in LibreShard yet.
import.reason.open: Stream Deck: Open (an app or file). Not available in LibreShard.
import.reason.website: Stream Deck: Website. Not available in LibreShard.
import.reason.multiaction: Stream Deck: a Multi Action. Will come with macros.
import.reason.plugin: Stream Deck: an action of the plugin "{detail}". Plugins can't be imported.
import.reason.other: Stream Deck: "{detail}", which LibreShard can't do.
import.reason.missingPage: Stream Deck: the folder this button opened is missing from the file.
import.reason.tooManyPages: Stream Deck: this folder would go over the limit of 50 pages.
shards.aiHint: Something more than a grid of buttons?
shards.aiGuide: Make a shard with an AI assistant
url.title: Install a shard from a web address
url.hint: Paste the address of a .libreshard or .zip file (https only). LibreShard downloads it and shows you its keys before installing anything.
download.error.badUrl: That isn't a valid web address.
download.error.notHttps: Only https:// addresses can be used, so nobody can change the file on its way.
download.error.privateAddress: {host} is on a private network. LibreShard only downloads shards from servers on the internet.
download.error.tooManyRedirects: The address redirects too many times.
download.error.httpStatus: The server answered with an error ({status}).
download.error.tooBig: The file is bigger than 50 MB, the limit for a shard.
download.error.timeout: The download took too long and was stopped.
download.error.network: The file couldn't be downloaded. Check the address and your connection.
link.installMessage: A web page wants to install a shard from {host}
link.installDetail: LibreShard will download it and show you its keys before installing anything. Continue only if you trust where it comes from.
review.fromGallery: From the LibreShard gallery: the file is the one that was reviewed.
gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.intro: Shards reviewed for LibreShard. As always, each one shows you its keys before installing.
gallery.idTaken: You already have another shard with this id: uninstall it first to install this one.
gallery.notFound: That shard isn't in the gallery (any more).
gallery.paidOnly: This shard is sold by its author: buy it on their page and open the file they give you.
gallery.needsApp: This shard needs LibreShard {version} or newer.
gallery.changed: The file isn't the one that was reviewed for the gallery, so it wasn't installed. The author may have changed it; try again later.
gallery.invalid: The gallery's list couldn't be read.
gallery.newerFormat: The gallery needs a newer version of LibreShard.
link.galleryMessage: Install "{name}" by {author} from the LibreShard gallery?
link.galleryDetail: LibreShard will download the reviewed file and show you its keys before installing anything.
shards.galleryHint: Shards reviewed for LibreShard, ready to install
shards.newHint: Make your own panel, no code needed
shards.updatesIntro: Shards with a new version in the gallery: {count}. Updating shows what changed first.
support.ask: LibreShard is free and open source. If it's been useful to you these weeks, you can support its development. We won't ask again.
about.supportHint: LibreShard is free and always will be, with nothing locked behind a payment. Donations (Ko-fi or GitHub Sponsors) help keep it going.
